answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the harbor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The tundra holds work receipts rather than names, so the gale of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
